SELECT u.id, u.username, u.nickname, u.avatar, u.email, u.phone, u.gender, u.status, u.last_login_time FROM sys_user u WHERE u.deleted = 0
AND u.id IN ( SELECT ud.user_id FROM sys_user_dept ud INNER JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = ud.dept_id AND d.deleted = 0 WHERE d.path LIKE CONCAT((SELECT d2.path FROM sys_dept d2 WHERE d2.id = #{query.deptId} AND d2.deleted = 0), '%') OR d.id = #{query.deptId} )
AND ( u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR u.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') )
AND u.status = #{query.status}
ORDER BY u.create_time DESC
